# Comments of a dictionary's orders together with long expressions and
# conditions, and through ALTER TABLE, DROP INDEX, sp_DropIndex and DROP TABLE:
# what the original frees of an order's comment, and where it stores one. The
# dictionary, de/de.add, is kept in fixtures/sql/spddidxcomment2/:
#
#     run.sh <work> <ace32.dll> spddidxcomment2.txt > ../../../fixtures/sql/spddidxcomment2.json
#     cp <work>/data/de/de.a* <work>/data/de/*.adt <work>/data/de/*.BAK ../../../fixtures/sql/spddidxcomment2/
ddcreate de\de.add

direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_CreateIndex90('t1', 't1.adi', 'i1', 'long_column_name_for_expressions_00 + long_column_name_for_expressions_01 + long_column_name_for_expressions_02 + long_column_name_for_expressions_03 + long_column_name_for_expressions_04 + long_column_name_for_expressions_05', '', 2, 512, '')
